description: Source code for plugin management in a vendor layer, including dynamic loading, initialization, starting, stopping, and optional factory reset parameter retrieval for plugins.

methods.name: PLUGIN_Load
methods.description: Loads a plugin from a specified path, checks for required symbols, and adds it to the plugin list.

methods.name: PLUGIN_Init
methods.description: Calls the vendor initialization function for all loaded plugins.

methods.name: PLUGIN_Start
methods.description: Starts all loaded plugins by calling their start functions.

methods.name: PLUGIN_Stop
methods.description: Stops all loaded plugins by calling their stop functions.

methods.name: PLUGIN_GetFactoryResetParams
methods.description: Retrieves factory reset parameters from all plugins that support it.
